title: Fix client API drift
description: docs/client-api. Account id should be DID (spec MUST) not IPNS name; epoch redefined as rotation counter; SigningRecord shape and signing payload defined 3 ways; extension fields top-level vs nested corundum key; duplicate /statuses/:id/curation with incompatible shapes; curation path mismatch; missing scopes and error codes; media id = bytes CID breaks ownership; README:29 says shim out of scope; shim: no native stream endpoint, /api/v1 collision, arrival-order IDs sort backfill as newest, edits need same id + status.update. Root README/spec 14 should point at client-api as non-normative.
close_reason: client-api aligned: DID account ids (percent-encoded), native API under /api/corundum/v1, shim owns /api/v1, JWS SigningRecord, two custody modes, client-signed DID updates, edits/deletes as activities, corundum:Error + Ch 38 cursors, scopes/codes complete, media id vs CID, public-only visibility, shim snowflakes from published time.
